questionText:
Consider the following Boolean expression of a function $F$ :

$$F(P, Q) = (\bar{P} + Q) \oplus (\bar{P}Q)$$

Which of the following expressions is/are equivalent to $F$ ?
explanation:
Step 1: Simplify the Boolean expression $F(P, Q)$
Recall that $A \oplus B = A\bar{B} + \bar{A}B$.
Let $A = \bar{P} + Q$ and $B = \bar{P}Q$.

• Compute $\bar{A}$ and $\bar{B}$:
$\bar{A} = \overline{\bar{P} + Q} = P\bar{Q}$
$\bar{B} = \overline{\bar{P}Q} = P + \bar{Q}$

• Compute $A\bar{B}$:
$A\bar{B} = (\bar{P} + Q)(P + \bar{Q}) = \bar{P}P + \bar{P}\bar{Q} + QP + Q\bar{Q} = 0 + \bar{P}\bar{Q} + PQ + 0 = PQ + \bar{P}\bar{Q}$

• Compute $\bar{A}B$:
$\bar{A}B = (P\bar{Q})(\bar{P}Q) = 0$

• Combine terms:
$F(P, Q) = A\bar{B} + \bar{A}B = PQ + \bar{P}\bar{Q} = \overline{P \oplus Q}$ (XNOR operation).

Step 2: Evaluate each option
• Option (A): $\overline{P \oplus Q} = PQ + \bar{P}\bar{Q}$ (Equivalent)
• Option (B): $P \oplus Q = P\bar{Q} + \bar{P}Q$ (XOR operation, Not equivalent)
• Option (C): $\bar{P} \oplus Q = \bar{P}\bar{Q} + \overline{\bar{P}}Q = \bar{P}\bar{Q} + PQ = \overline{P \oplus Q}$ (Equivalent)
• Option (D): $\bar{P} \oplus \bar{Q} = \bar{P}\overline{\bar{Q}} + \overline{\bar{P}}\bar{Q} = \bar{P}Q + P\bar{Q} = P \oplus Q$ (Not equivalent)

Therefore, the correct options are A and C.
